summary: Frontend-only Vox + Work carousel verification completed on public preview URL. Core P0 navigation, scroll-lock, source fidelity, responsive tables, image loading, and pawl-sound behavior passed; no blocking defects reproduced.

integration_issues.issue: Direct runtime counter validation for AudioContext close/listener cleanup was not deterministically captured in one late-injected instrumentation pass, though no user-facing regressions/errors were observed and route-change behavior remained stable.

action_items: Optional: if strict proof is required, add a small dev-only diagnostic hook around usePawlSound teardown to assert AudioContext.close() on route unmount in CI.
Optional perf polish: review non-blocking preload warnings for assets that are preloaded but not consumed quickly.
critical_code_review_comments: Vox content fidelity checks passed against supplied native text files: repeated Problem Statement block in Competitive Analysis is preserved, and no fabricated section copy was detected.
All requested Vox research/prototype table structures are present with unique data-testid values and expected row counts (heuristics=8, comparison=14, priorities=8).
Work carousel interaction logic in useSnapWheel/useWorkCarousel reflects finite cooldown and per-gesture stepping; runtime verification confirmed no permanent wheel lock and correct indicator sync.

main_agent_followup.audio_teardown_evidence_gap: Resolved. Instrumentation before app startup verified an AudioContext becomes running after trusted user input, all created contexts become closed after Work-to-Vox navigation, and both sound-specific pointerdown/keydown listeners are removed. Initial broad listener assertion also counted unrelated platform handlers; narrowed assertion targets only usePawlSound prepare callback.
main_agent_followup.remaining: Non-blocking existing preload warnings only; no known broken core flow.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on https://portfolio-landing-96.preview.emergentagent.com. Passed: Vox tile click + Enter, native Ctrl/Cmd+click and middle-click new-tab semantics to /portfolio/vox, direct reload title and heading focus, both Back to Work links reset to first tile, Poonch still navigates, drag/touch/cancel gestures do not accidentally activate Vox link, wheel progression one-step with finite cooldown and endpoint behavior, indicators/live region sync, mute persistence and no-op boundary sound suppression, Vox copy/table/link fidelity, all 11 wireframes + 10 prototype screens + flow image load, success assets dimensions 390x844, responsive no horizontal overflow at 320/768/1024/1440, mobile table labels readable, desktop prototype overlap + mobile stack behavior, reduced-motion content visibility. Observed only non-blocking console preload warnings.
rca of the issue: No production blocker reproduced. One failed sub-check in mobile touch/audio script was test-sequencing related (attempted navigation after an intentional cancel-suppressed click), not an app defect.
